title: Strong Duality Thresholds and Minimum Curvature for the Nearest Rectangular Symplectic Matrix Problem
summary: We study the nearest rectangular symplectic matrix problem in the squared Frobenius norm for arbitrary targets $T\in\mathbb R^{2n\times2k}$, with $n\ge k$. We prove that its semidefinite relaxation is exact for every target if and only if $n\ge2k-1$. Under this condition, the primal problem, the relaxation, and both Lagrangian dual problems attain the same optimal value. In this range, we derive the exact minimum Rayleigh quotient of the Riemannian Hessian at every feasible point under the Euclidean induced metric, and prove that all second-order stationary points are global minimizers.
